title: HTTP 接口设计：会话历史与消息提交的可核对合同
summary: 承接09.01用例与S2内存受理、04.03HTTP语义，面向Go初学者为虚构IM只读历史GET和提交消息POST定义路径、JSON表示、方法/状态、查询limit/opaque cursor/filter、错误体、内容类型与独立资源限额。静态教材无真实服务运行。
objectives: 把读历史和发送用例映射为一致的资源与方法
区分200内存受理与201/202可能暗示的其他合同
定义分页次序、排他cursor、limit及过滤顺序
区分请求体总字节上限与消息正文上限
设计稳定错误码与HTTP状态而不泄漏身份信息
用响应丢失和重复提交检验HTTP与业务幂等边界
写出可供后续net/http实现与httptest核对的合同矩阵

sections.title: 一、从09.01两张用例卡定义资源
sections.focus: u-a/u-b/c-a/m-a虚构，当前项目仅本地CLI。GET /v1/conversations/c-a/messages读取、POST同路径提交，成功点仅S2进程内存受理；主体由未来可信认证边界，客户端sender_id不可信。路径版本/v1非本地JSON v1。先写请求/响应/状态合同再Go handler。

sections.title: 二、GET历史：方法、表示与授权
sections.focus: GET safe/read-only，查询limit默认20范围1..100，before不透明游标，optional sender=u-b过滤；只读已授权c-a，按内存本地accept seq降序，过滤后分页，next_cursor null意味本次无更早项不保证永远/完整；Cache-Control no-store/Content-Type application/json，空messages[]合法。无真实查询服务。

sections.title: 三、分页游标与变动数据的边界
sections.focus: 静态数据m1 seq1,m2 seq2,m3 seq3，limit2返回m3,m2 + cursorexclusive before m2，下一页m1；若m4中间新增，旧cursor不重复新项，但跨重启内存序号失效；游标绑定会话、排序和过滤，拒绝错会话/畸形；不把游标当认证令牌/永久历史快照。过滤先于分页，顺序稳定、同序tie规则若必要。

sections.title: 四、POST消息：输入、内存受理与重复
sections.focus: POST /v1/conversations/c-a/messages, Content-Type application/json, body {message_id:m-a,body:你好}, no trusted sender field；原始HTTP请求体上限例4096B、正文6UTF8字节沿10.01、本地文件1MiB不同。成功200 OK body status accepted_in_memory, not durable/queue/delivery; duplicate same c-a/m-a409 conflict, original unchanged, request response lost unknown; no idempotent retry guarantee yet。

sections.title: 五、HTTP状态与稳定错误体
sections.focus: map 200 query/accepted, 400 bad param/syntax, 401 invalid auth per challenge requirement later, 403 forbidden,404 missing/hidden,409 duplicate,413 body too large,415 unsupported media,500 unexpected; missing response is not status. JSON error shape {error:{code,message}}, machine code stable, message non-sensitive; RFC9457 is alternative standard not claim our body conforms, explain if adopted use application/problem+json and type as primary. 201 vs202 vs200 semantics choice。

sections.title: 六、内容类型、版本、缓存与限额
sections.focus: Content-Type request/response, Accept if excludes JSON 406 by explicit teaching contract, charset/UTF8 and byte length, Cache-Control no-store for sensitive history not authentication/TLS。/v1 API version distinct from local v1 file schema, unknown fields/version rejection policy, fixed default/max limit and raw body max not silently vary. Go net/http implementation deferred 09.03。

sections.title: 七、失败时间线与接口评审
sections.focus: DNS/connection vs HTTP status (04.02), trusted identity and object auth before data, request canceled/timeout may be after in-memory commit so caller result unknown, duplicate retrial409; no automatically safe retry. For each response check status, code, body, before/after memory; no online delivery. Security privacy of errors, no raw body/token logs. Table of negative cases, source RFC9110/9457/OWASP。

sections.title: 八、完整契约矩阵与分层练习
sections.focus: give request/response snippets for GET empty and POST accepted plus one error, all static and byte coherent if Content-Length shown; 22 exercises gradual: method/path, 200 vs201/202, pagination, filter, status, error body, caps, unknown outcomes, business evidence. Learner later personal net/http+httptest, current no Go/network/site build. Next09.03 handlers/domain/adapters。
